verdict.rationale: Signifyd is a fraud-decisioning platform, so passing agent identity into the risk decision is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents fields or support for agentic-payment protocols, signed agent tokens, or delegated spending scopes as decision inputs. The Checkout and Sale endpoints take only generic order and payment details, which do not establish agent-identity signals.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pass verified agent identity — agentic-payment protocols, signed agent tokens, delegated spending scopes — into the risk decision as a first-class signal
